content.text: You’ve built a digital product. Ebook. Course. Template. Beats. Now you need to sell it. But Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle — all locked. Not just restricted. Unavailable. You’re in Nigeria. Or Ghana. Or Pakistan. Conventional platforms exclude you by design. Not by accident. Their infrastructure depends on banking systems your country doesn’t integrate with. Their compliance teams flag your IP address. Their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-10|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors block your currency. Workarounds fail. VPNs get detected. Proxy payments through friends in the US or UK collapse under volume. You need base-layer infrastructure. Not a hack. Not a temporary fix. A [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-11|sovereign]] commerce stack you own. Deployed on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare. Backend logic in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Orders stored in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-8|How Supabase]] or Google Sheets. Files delivered via Google Drive or R2. Payments processed on-chain through NOWPayments. No platform owns your data. No subscription fees. No sudden account freezes. This is the architecture COREMERCH deploys. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe. Built for creators Stripe locked out.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer convenience — until they don’t. They handle payment processing, order management, and product delivery in one dashboard. But this convenience comes with dependencies. Your store runs on their servers. Your data lives in their databases. Your payment processing relies on their banking partnerships. When they exclude your country, you’re locked out. Sovereign commerce infrastructure flips this model. You own the hosting. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are free and globally accessible. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script — no server costs. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets — you control the data. Files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 — no platform middleman. Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments — 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) gives you all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack. No platform owns your store. No subscription fees. No country restrictions. You own the infrastructure. You control the flow. This is not a workaround. It’s a permanent structural alternative.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle exclude countries based on banking infrastructure, regulatory risk, and compliance costs. Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Venezuela — these markets are deemed too risky. Their exclusion is not temporary. It’s structural. Their business model depends on partnerships with banks and payment processors that avoid these regions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It doesn’t rely on traditional banking. It uses on-chain crypto payments. NOWPayments verifies transactions automatically the moment they confirm on-chain. No buyer account required. No KYC. No platform dependence. The stack is deployed on globally accessible services like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, and Google Sheets. No region is excluded. No currency is blocked. This is infrastructure built for the people Stripe locked out. It’s not a fix for their system. It’s a replacement.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms promise fast payouts — until they hold your funds for 30 days. Or freeze your account. Or charge 3-5% per transaction. Sovereign commerce infrastructure delivers instant payments. NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain in minutes. Fees are 0.5%. No hidden costs. No chargebacks. No account freezes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. You choose the network. You control the flow. Deployment costs are minimal. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are free. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are free for low to moderate usage. Supabase and Google Sheets are free for small-scale stores. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) gives you all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack. No monthly fees. No platform taxes. Just a one-time investment in infrastructure you own. This is not cheaper than Stripe. It’s structurally different. It’s built for creators who need sovereignty, not convenience.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround. It’s a permanent structural alternative.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your store. They control your data. They decide when and how you get paid. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store runs on infrastructure you deploy. Your data is stored in databases you control. Your payments are processed on-chain — no platform middleman. Automation is built into the stack. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Orders are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered automatically from Google Drive or R2. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all templates and blueprints to set this up. No manual intervention required. No platform dependence. Delivery is instant. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the webhook fires. The buyer gets their product. No waiting for platform approval. No risk of account suspension. This is infrastructure designed for creators who need control, not convenience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a country Stripe and PayPal exclude, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only permanent solution. Workarounds fail under volume. Proxy payments collapse. VPNs get detected. You need a stack you own. Deployed on globally accessible services. Processing payments on-chain. Storing data in databases you control. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) gives you all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack. If you’re selling 1-5 products, start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). If you need more scale, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. If you want full documentation, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes all source code and scaling guides. This is not a temporary fix. It’s a structural alternative.
